summary.claim_checked: Neither red6 dmn-check nor bpmn.io dmnlint has a missing-rule (gap) check
summary.verdict: CONFIRMED by execution and by reading the installed code: no gap/missing-rule/unused-value/undeclared-value report on any file, although every file has 17-6480 missing states; no such rule/validator exists in dmn-check 1.1.6, 1.4.0 or master, or in dmnlint 0.2.0/1.0.0/2.0.0
